notes.text: Load the widget with next/script and lazyOnload instead of a plain tag in <head>.

rewrite.before:
Unlock the Power of Next-Generation Scheduling

Tidepool is an all-in-one AI-powered platform that streamlines your workflow and empowers your team to achieve more.
rewrite.after:
Stop spending Monday morning texting people to cover sick calls.

Tidepool is shift scheduling for independent veterinary clinics. It drafts your weekly rota from staff availability and your coverage rules, and when someone calls in sick, it texts eligible staff and fills the shift for you.

bars.label: Users per arm, meant to be 50/50

notes.title: Fragile lift
notes.text: Up 2.0 points, but it disappears if 35 or fewer of the 640 missing users would have succeeded.

notes.title: Slower, not faster
notes.text: Median onboarding time went up by 36 seconds.

notes.title: Fastest path
notes.text: Find the 640 users in the flag tool's assignment log and re-run. Days, not another two-week test.
